about_short_description.short_description: reflect is the end-to-end platform to power every therapy private practice.

product.name: Therapist Matching Service
product.description: A service that matches clients with therapists based on a proprietary algorithm considering client needs and therapist practice styles.

product.name: Therapist Network and Screening
product.description: A network of licensed therapists who undergo screening and continuous quality monitoring to ensure standards of care.

product.name: Billing and Insurance Support
product.description: A service that assists clients with billing, negotiates rates with therapists, and manages out-of-network insurance claims and reimbursements.

product.name: Teletherapy Services
product.description: Remote therapy sessions conducted via video or phone, providing flexible access to licensed therapists.

product.name: Therapy Services for Employers
product.description: A program that helps employers provide mental health therapy access to employees through Reflect's matching and therapy network.

product.name: Doctor Referral Service
product.description: A referral system that helps healthcare providers connect patients with suitable therapists using Reflect's matching technology.
